title: Preserve authored timer marks and visibility
scope: Retain GPIF Timer visibility and any explicit authored value without confusing it with a derived playback timer.
acceptance: Distinguish no timer, a requested derived timer and an explicitly authored timer value.
Preserve nonzero and zero authored values at the exact beat.
Public edits and independent GP8 consumption retain the supported distinction; invalid values have a defined diagnostic.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Reproduced at tracks[0].staves[0].bars[0].voices[0].beats[0].showTimer. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.
Exact ordinary-beat source and edited output values before MIDI generation.
Reproducible retaining-source grace timer99 with exact diagnostic and target omission.
Hash-bound source, actual output artifacts, raw consumer values and residual acceptance.

resolution: Implemented Beat.Timer as the sole authority for absence, requested derived time and an explicit integer millisecond value including zero. Ordinary-beat source and public edits retain exact final pinned consumer states and independent repeated occurrences. Invalid source and authored values are diagnosed. Grace-beat conversion has no timer destination and now reports that exact source loss; broader any-beat acceptance remains residual under #108. Awaiting fresh different-agent review and integrated gates/probe; not marked solved.
verification: Public valid source regression fails against the previous effect reader and passes with three distinct timer states.
Exact raw source/output facts retain all 14 beat addresses, notes, derived/null flags and explicit safe-integer boundary values; original GP7 timer fixture also passes.
Negative, fractional, nonnumeric and overflowing source values fail strict parsing; invalid public values hard reject even with an allowance.
Grace timer 99 retaining-source versus omitted-target artifacts reproduce the remaining source limitation with a strict parse diagnostic.
Focused checks only; root owns full conformance, capability probe and prek.
